about_short_description.short_description: Nest Genomics is a lab-agnostic, comprehensive software solution for implementing genomic programs at scale.

product.name: Nest Genetics Copilot
product.description: A software platform that integrates genomic programs into clinical workflows, providing patient identification, clinical decision support, and educational resources.

product.name: EMR Integration
product.description: Integration of the Nest platform with electronic medical records to enable seamless access to genomic decision support within clinical workflows.

product.name: Genomic Program Analytics
product.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into patient navigation, clinical performance metrics, and return on investment for genomic programs.

product.name: Coordinated Genomic Care Management
product.description: A service that connects patients, providers, and care navigators to ensure informed decision-making throughout the genomic care journey.
